CommunityApplications.Profile: featherdrop is a sleek, modern, self-hosted file sharer for Unraid. Open the page, drop a file, set an expiry (plus an optional password or download limit), and share a short link or QR code. Files are encrypted at rest (age), uploads are resumable (tus), and metadata lives in a single SQLite file — no separate database, no accounts, no tracking. 26 languages, light/dark, and custom branding (name, logo, accent). A lightweight, privacy-first alternative to heavier sharing platforms. Maintained by junkerderprovinz.
